title: Multi-Site Jobs Scraper
description: Scrapes IT job listings from multiple job sites, for any location LinkedIn supports. Pick which sites to scrape, which keywords to search, and which location to target — no coding required.

websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Which job sites to scrape. To add a new site: create a handler in src/sites/, register it in src/sites/index.js, then add its id here.

keywords.title: Job Title/Keywords
keywords.description: Job titles/keywords to search for on each selected site.

location.title: Location
location.description: Job location, e.g. 'Singapore', 'Egypt', 'Remote'. Only applies to sites whose search takes a location parameter — note that MyCareersFuture only returns results for Singapore regardless of this value.

maxPages.title: Number of Pages
maxPages.description: How many result pages to scrape, per site, per keyword.

useProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useProxy.description: Enable IP rotation (recommended to avoid blocks). Uses compute units but highly recommended.
